name: Hacker News
tagline: Hacker News front page, with article text and optional Gemini summaries
description: Browse Hacker News without leaving Gloomberb. Top, New, Best, Show, and Ask feeds with scores and comment counts. Opening a story shows a reader-view extract of the linked article, fetched from the article's own site, and s summarises it with Gemini when an API key is set.
